_note: Word-level function tags, loaded by other-tools/import-vocab-tags.js. Built from a curated core list plus one hop through vocabulary.synonyms, then hand-reviewed. Synonym expansion produced obvious noise (mineral, crop, productivity) which was removed; borderline entries (rationalize, defy, expose, sanction, contend) were dropped rather than guessed at.
_scope_note: These describe how a word FUNCTIONS in an argument, not what it means. function:addition therefore holds discourse markers (furthermore, likewise) and NOT semantic 'add' verbs like accumulate or append. Words legitimately carrying two functions (yield = produce and concede; nevertheless = contrast and concession) are listed under both.
_missing_note: Basic connectives (however, moreover, albeit, thus, therefore, arguably, ostensibly) are absent from the vocabulary table because the SAT/IELTS source lists only cover advanced words. import-connectives.js adds them and tags them.
